content:
Apple TV subscribers can watch the first two episodes of 《Last Seen》, an Australian kidnapping thriller starring Patrick Brammall from 《Glitch》. Watch the trailer below.

The first two episodes of 《Last Seen》 are now streaming on Apple TV.

Less than a month after Apple TV first announced 《Last Seen》, the platform has already rolled out the first two episodes of this brand-new six-part thriller.

Adapted from award-winning author Ryan David Jahn's novel 《The Dispatcher》, new episodes will drop every Wednesday through October 7.

《Last Seen》 kicks off Apple TV's fall slate, which also features the sixth season of 《Slow Horses》, 《Brothers》 with Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, the film 《Matchbox: The Movie》, and the second season of 《Where's Wanda?》, among others.

The platform also just premiered 《Mayday》, starring Ryan Reynolds（《Deadpool》） and Kenneth Branagh（《Oppenheimer》）.
